review.head: bdcbec316523787f376d53a57bb2ab14712eee52
findings: P2: mirror moon disk plus separate GGX moon glint
P2: absolute float32 coordinates quantize short wave phases far from origin

accepted: Opaque shadow preflight; no ray count, bounce count or resolution reduction
Underwater absorption and distance haze using the PR medium coefficients
Cloud edge refinement: user explicitly approved measured cost; default 1, option 0 retained
knownOpen: Dense forest/underwater scenes remain far above 16 ms; GI and rough reflections dominate
Distant fog shimmer has not been fixed or causally isolated
32-chunk failure and long-travel stability have not been resolved by these short runs
Moon-facing glint and large-coordinate/long-session wave appearance still need in-game acceptance
No caustic pattern is added to the underwater-camera path; the PR pattern remains in above-water refraction
measurementLimits: CPU active-thread time has 15.625 ms granularity and excludes blocked GPU waits
VK_EXT_memory_budget peak is a sampled current-process allocation estimate, not guaranteed residency or transient peak
Own native allocation counters exclude Sodium, Minecraft and NGX allocations

A/B geometry matches exactly within every run. Separately generated day/sunset runs use identical seed/location/settings but can have different complete source-mesh fingerprints; do not claim cross-run bit-identical worlds
Static timing phases have independent stochastic samples/histories. Only the eight-frame quality sequences match all physical uniforms
No broad claim of leak freedom; short runs retired owned allocations and NGX contexts, with no tracked allocation failures

rejectedEvidence.reason: User changed gamemode; candidate foreground hand differs. Replaced by motion-2.
Development shader include guard error; corrected and rerun as day-2. Not evidence for the user 32-chunk failure.
